items.title: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering in Returnal: measured, not eyeballed
body: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering can produce a dramatic before-and-after image. I tested it in Returnal at 4K to find out how much of the difference survives measurement, which controls genuinely matter, and what the effect costs in motion.

Switching it on increased measured edge detail by about 50% on the character crop and 29% on the environment crop. Natural at Intensity 1.0 was the important choice, while Local Structure 2.0 scored higher but made foliage visibly speckled.
The full write-up includes the floating-point method, the corrected performance figures, lower-generation GPU evidence, final settings, and every conclusion that changed after a second test.
